title: AI Charter Certification
description: Public contract for certifying an AI model, an agent built on one, or a physical autonomous bot, per the Universal AI Charter's governance and disclosure articles. A certification covers origin, training, capability, and decision-making disclosure for exactly one subject and one version.

schema.description: Schema version marker. Bump this when the contract changes in a breaking way.

certificationId.description: Opaque, immutable identifier for this certification, assigned once at issue time and never recomputed. Format 'urn:ai-charter:cert:<uuid>'. Not derived from content, so updating disclosure fields never changes it. Resolve it in the public registry to cross-verify.

subjectType.description: Whether this certification covers a base model, a specialized agent built on top of one, or a physical autonomous bot.

ownerType.description: Who holds the certification: a registered company, a named individual, or a non-profit/public body.

originCountry.description: Country where the model or agent originates. May be empty when undisclosed.

modelName.description: Name of the model, or of the agent when subjectType is 'agent'.

version.description: Version identifier this certification applies to.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the certification.

agentSpecialization.description: Required, non-empty when subjectType is 'agent': what the agent specializes in, e.g. 'Grid outage dispatch'. Empty when subjectType is 'model'.

botCategory.description: Required, non-empty when subjectType is 'autonomous-bot': its operating domain, e.g. 'civil', 'military', 'industrial', 'agricultural'. Empty for a model or an agent. Open-ended.

modalities.description: What the model or agent can produce or understand, e.g. 'Text Generation', 'Image Understanding'. Open-ended list, not a fixed enum: propose additions at /ai-charter/placards' sibling reference, or via pull request.

parameterScale.description: Freeform training parameter scale disclosure, e.g. '7B', '24B', '1.8T', or 'Undisclosed'.

present.description: Whether output is fingerprinted or watermarked.

method.description: How the fingerprint/watermark works. Empty when present is false.

fingerprint.description: Charter governance disclosure: AI tokens must be fingerprinted to protect intellectual property.

trainingSources.description: Disclosure of the sources used to train the model or agent.

agenticDecisionMaking.description: Whether the model or agent makes decisions on its own, without a human confirming each one.

hazardCategories.description: Hazard placard labels disclosed for this certification, HAZMAT-style. Open-ended list; see /ai-charter/placards for the reference set and severity coding.

complianceStandards.description: Optional. Data-handling and regulatory standards the subject is certified to meet, e.g. 'PII Handling', 'HIPAA (PHI)', 'GDPR', 'Classified / SECRET'. Open-ended; absence means none disclosed.

operatingRegions.description: Optional. Regions the subject is cleared to operate in, e.g. 'North America (NA)', 'European Union (EU/EEA)', 'Asia-Pacific (APAC)'. Open-ended; absence means unspecified.

riskTier.description: Optional. EU AI Act risk tier the subject self-classifies under.

nistFunctions.description: Optional. NIST AI Risk Management Framework core functions this certification addresses.

energyProfile.description: Optional. Measured energy or compute profile, e.g. '0.8 kWh per 1M tokens' or a training-compute figure.

incidentReferences.description: Optional. Public URLs to logged incidents behind unintendedConsequences, e.g. an AI Incident Database entry.

nextDisclosureDate.description: Optional. Next yearly decision-disclosure due date, YYYY-MM-DD.

publicKeyUrl.description: URL where the issuer's public key can be fetched.

value.description: Base64 detached signature over the certification with this field removed.

signature.description: Optional. Issuer-provided detached signature over the certification, for provenance.

decisionCategorization.description: Yearly categorization/sub-categorization of decisions the model or agent took, e.g. { category: 'Healthcare', subcategory: 'Diagnosis Support' }.

unintendedConsequences.description: Unintended consequences already on record for this model or agent. Empty string means none reported.

issuedDate.description: Date this certification was issued, YYYY-MM-DD.

effectiveDate.description: Date this certification takes effect, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Date this certification ends, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty string means open-ended, must not be earlier than effectiveDate when set.
